calls.title: Online Experimentation Training
calls.summary: The team discussed a plan to build a hub for experiment replications, focusing on pre-designed templates to facilitate quicker implementation, aiming to significantly increase the number of experiments conducted. Jakub Linowski emphasized the need for aggregated data for meta analysis while Ashley Stirrup highlighted the importance of user consent for participating companies and the option for anonymity. They also planned a beginner-friendly training course targeting new users of Growth Book, covering essential aspects of running experiments from setup to analysis. Additionally, the conversation included strategies for selecting impactful experiments and considerations for API integration to streamline data sharing, with the ultimate goal of enhancing customer engagement and brand visibility.
calls.keywords: A/B testing, experiment replication, meta-analysis, Growth Book, e-commerce, training course
